description: Demonstrates the number-normalization rule from section 2 of the spec: an artifact whose 'version' field arrives as a JSON float (1.0, as A2A's protobuf Struct transport would deliver it) must canonicalize and digest IDENTICALLY to the same artifact with 'version' as a JSON integer (1). This is not a sign/verify case -- it isolates the canonicalization+digest step so an implementer can check it without needing a key pair at all.
non_example_note: A non-integer float (e.g. 1.5) or a decimal/monetary value is NEVER normalized this way -- this protocol only ever puts integers or decimal strings in a legitimate artifact, so this rule only ever fires on an integer-valued float. A conformant implementation must not generalize this into rounding or truncating arbitrary floats.
